truth_policy.source_of_truth: existing ICOS Work OS / PostgreSQL & event log; target imported once or read-only projection, never parallel mission DB
truth_policy.completion_rule: Only mark complete after requirements, code/artifacts, tests, independent review, relevant IntegrationGate, observability, rollback and outcome links all verified for the node scope.
truth_policy.progress_rule: No denominator or percentage until scoped leaf nodes are reconciled and evidence verified; unknown !== 0%, never use invented progress.
